_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Codelist profile UML. The profile is defined at metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/archive/CDIFCodelistProfile/CDIFCodelistProfileSchema.json and composes the W3C SKOS skosConceptScheme + skosConcept building blocks with CDIF-specific constraints. Approach: target classes are named after the JSON-schema vocabulary (ConceptScheme, Concept). Each class uses mappingType=new with optional v1.1 sourceClass to preserve a provenance Dependency back to the DDI-CDI source (ConceptSystem, Concept). Attributes are authored explicitly using SKOS names; data types are the UML primitives String/Boolean/Integer/Real plus DDI-CDI XsdAnyUri/XsdDate (the structured DDI-CDI types InternationalString/LabelForDisplay/ObjectName are deliberately flattened to String here per CDIF profile policy — multilingual labels are encoded inline using JSON-LD @language tags, not as nested LanguageString objects). Associations between target classes are declared with the v1.1 new-association form (no sourceAssociationName).

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Codelist Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Controlled vocabulary codelists expressed as SKOS Concept Schemes
targetModel.definition: CDIF profile for controlled-vocabulary codelists implemented as SKOS ConceptSchemes. Each concept must have a resolvable @id, skos:inScheme, skos:definition and skos:prefLabel. The scheme must declare skos:hasTopConcept; concepts in a hierarchy must declare both skos:narrower (downward) and skos:broader (upward). CDIF metadata properties (schema:identifier, schema:dateModified, schema:license or schema:conditionsOfAccess) take precedence over the equivalent dcterms properties from the base skosConceptScheme building block. Required attributes per the profile JSON schema and rules.shacl: ConceptScheme @id, schema:identifier, schema:dateModified, skos:hasTopConcept, plus (license OR conditionsOfAccess); Concept @id, skos:inScheme, skos:definition, skos:prefLabel, skos:notation.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Profile for controlled-vocabulary codelists as SKOS ConceptSchemes.

package.name: Classes
package.definition: Classes of the CDIF Codelist profile: ConceptScheme (the codelist) and Concept (the codes).

package.name: Support
package.definition: Supporting structured types: Identifier, DefinedTerm, Reference (stubs; full definitions in CDIFCore).

class._comment: skos:ConceptScheme. v1.1 sourceClass=ConceptSystem preserves the provenance Dependency without forcing the DDI-CDI attribute vocabulary. All attributes are authored explicitly in SKOS / CDIF terms. Cross-reference: ddicdiCodeList/schema.yaml in metadataBuildingBlocks (CodeList is the closest DDI-CDI BB; it has cdi:identifier, cdi:name, cdi:purpose, cdi:allowsDuplicates as attributes plus has_Code / has_CodePosition / references / uses / isDefinedBy associations). ConceptSystem is the better semantic match for skos:ConceptScheme but has no dedicated BB yet.
class.definition: A SKOS Concept Scheme - an aggregation of one or more SKOS Concepts, forming a controlled vocabulary or codelist. CDIF requires a resolvable @id, schema:identifier, schema:dateModified, and skos:hasTopConcept, plus either schema:license or schema:conditionsOfAccess.

attribute.name: prefLabel
attribute.definition: skos:prefLabel - the preferred lexical label for the concept scheme. Required.

attribute.name: altLabel
attribute.definition: skos:altLabel - alternative lexical labels (acronyms, abbreviations, variants).

attribute.name: hiddenLabel
attribute.definition: skos:hiddenLabel - labels accessible to free-text search but not displayed.

attribute._comment: Per ddicdiCodeList: DDI-CDI uses cdi:purpose (InternationalString) for the scheme-level explanation. Flattened here to String per CDIF profile policy; @language tags carry the locale.
attribute.name: definition
attribute.definition: skos:definition - formal explanation of the meaning or purpose of this concept scheme. DDI-CDI cdi:purpose carries the same semantics.

attribute.name: notation
attribute.definition: skos:notation - classification code or notation for this concept scheme.

attribute.name: note
attribute.definition: skos:note - general note about the concept scheme.

attribute.name: scopeNote
attribute.definition: skos:scopeNote - note clarifying the intended scope of the concept scheme.

attribute.name: historyNote
attribute.definition: skos:historyNote - note about the history of the concept scheme.

attribute.name: changeNote
attribute.definition: skos:changeNote - note documenting a change to the concept scheme.

attribute.name: editorialNote
attribute.definition: skos:editorialNote - note for editors, translators, and maintainers.

attribute.name: example
attribute.definition: skos:example - example of the use of this concept scheme.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: schema:identifier - primary CDIF identifier for the codelist (URI). Required by the CDIF Codelist profile.

attribute.name: dateModified
attribute.definition: schema:dateModified - ISO 8601 date the codelist was last modified. Required.

attribute.name: datePublished
attribute.definition: dcterms:created / schema:datePublished - date the concept scheme was created.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - web location of a page describing the codelist.

attribute.name: license
attribute.definition: schema:license - license for the codelist. Either license or conditionsOfAccess is required.

attribute.name: conditionsOfAccess
attribute.definition: schema:conditionsOfAccess - text statement of access conditions. Either license or conditionsOfAccess is required.

attribute.name: version
attribute.definition: schema:version - version identifier for the concept scheme.

sssom.predicate_label: ConceptScheme is the SKOS-vocabulary expression of a DDI-CDI ConceptSystem with profile-specific CDIF identifier/date/access constraints.
sssom.comment: Class semantics align. Attribute vocabulary is SKOS + CDIF rather than DDI-CDI.

class._comment: skos:Concept (as constrained by CDIF's CdifCodelistConcept). Required by SHACL: @id, skos:inScheme, skos:definition, skos:prefLabel, skos:notation; if skos:narrower is present then a skos:broader pointing back is also required (enforced at instance level, not in the UML model).
class.definition: A SKOS Concept constrained for CDIF codelist use. Must have a resolvable @id, skos:inScheme, skos:definition, and skos:prefLabel.

attribute.name: prefLabel
attribute.definition: skos:prefLabel - preferred lexical label for this concept. Required.

attribute.name: notation
attribute.definition: skos:notation - classification code for this concept within a scheme. Required by the CDIF Codelist profile.

attribute.name: definition
attribute.definition: skos:definition - formal explanation of the meaning of this concept. Required by CDIF.

attribute.name: scopeNote
attribute.definition: skos:scopeNote - note clarifying meaning and/or intended use.

attribute.name: note
attribute.definition: skos:note - general note about this concept.

attribute.name: historyNote
attribute.definition: skos:historyNote - note about past state or use.

attribute.name: changeNote
attribute.definition: skos:changeNote - note documenting a change.

attribute.name: editorialNote
attribute.definition: skos:editorialNote - note for editors and maintainers.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI identifier for this concept. Required by CDIF.

sssom.predicate_label: skos:Concept is the SKOS-vocabulary expression of a DDI-CDI Concept with CDIF profile requirements.
sssom.comment: Class name matches; attribute vocabulary is SKOS rather than DDI-CDI structured types.

class._comment: Identifier (schema:PropertyValue) stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'Identifier' resolve inside this profile; the canonical definition lives in the CDIFCore profile.
class.definition: schema:PropertyValue / schema:Identifier (stub). A structured identifier with a propertyID (scheme), value, and optional url. Full definition in CDIFCore::Identifier.

attribute.name: propertyId
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - the identifier scheme (e.g. DOI, Handle, ROR).

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: schema:value - the identifier value.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - resolvable form of the identifier.

class._comment: Reference (cdif:Reference) stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'Reference' resolve inside this profile; the canonical definition lives in the CDIFCore profile and the cdifDataType/cdifReference building block.
class.definition: cdif:Reference (stub). A typed reference to an external entity. Full definition in CDIFCore::Reference and cdifDataType/cdifReference.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI of the referenced resource.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - human-readable label for the URI.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short summary of the referenced resource.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - resolvable URL (when distinct from the @id).

association._comment: skos:hasTopConcept - top concepts of the scheme. Required by CDIF on the scheme.
association.definition: skos:hasTopConcept. Top-level concepts that have no skos:broader in this scheme. Required for hierarchical codelists; the array must be non-empty.

association._comment: skos:inScheme - every Concept declares its containing ConceptScheme. Required by CDIF.
association.definition: skos:inScheme. The concept scheme this concept belongs to. Required for CDIF codelist concepts.

association._comment: skos:broader - upward hierarchy navigation. Required on any concept appearing as a skos:narrower value of another.
association.definition: skos:broader. Broader (parent) concepts in the hierarchy.
skos:narrower. Narrower (child) concepts in the hierarchy.
